new: ظرفیتِ رشته با کمینهٔ مورد انتظارِ $n$ سلول کم می‌شود؛ رابطهٔ زیر تقریبی مجانبی و محافظه‌کار است (برای ۵۲ سلول مقدارِ دقیق حدودِ $2.25\,\sigma$ است، نه $2.81\,\sigma$):
why: sigma*sqrt(2 ln n) is the large-n asymptote/upper approximation of the expected extreme of n normals; for n = 52 the exact expected minimum is about 2.25 sigma, so the printed string losses are ~25 % high. Saying so keeps the approximation honest.
evidence: Monte Carlo of 200,000 sets of 52 standard normals: mean minimum -2.265; sqrt(2 ln 52) = 2.811.

why: Same asymptotic sqrt(2 ln n) approximation for the expected maximum of 416 cells overstates it by ~16 %; harmless for sizing (conservative) but it is not the expected value.
evidence: Monte Carlo of 100,000 sets of 416 standard normals: mean maximum 2.980; sqrt(2 ln 416) = 3.473.
